shared_elements: bird-like or small animal figures in profile
repeated geometric marks or patterned bands
justification: Both surfaces include schematic human/anthropomorphic figures together with profile animals and some repeated abstract signs, with the closest correspondence being simplified profile creatures associated on the same decorated field with human-like figures. The major difference is that A is a broad, scattered hunting/herding-like scene dominated by many red stick humans and large quadrupeds, whereas B is a vertically organized relief with stacked registers, dense symbolic motifs, and no matching narrative arrangement.
